description: Pinned r0b0tlab ExLlamaV3 fork 5ddae7d1 and creator HTTP server. Text only, 262,144-token window, FP16 KV and one stream. Plain decoding avoids the DSpark output divergence reported upstream. Exact creator checkpoint, immutable CUDA 13.0 image and hash-locked Torch 2.14.0 cu130 dependencies. The memory envelope is a conservative estimate; container and physical model acceptance remain separate.
title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 EXL3 6.08bpw text (r0b0tlab)
